desc.zh: 用回溯枚举切分，用 last 修正乘法优先级。
desc.en: Enumerate cuts with backtracking and preserve precedence with last.

complexity: O(n·3^n) time excluding output; O(n) recursion auxiliary space

concepts.name: Backtracking choices
concepts.description: Cut or join each digit gap and undo after recursion.

concepts.name: Precedence repair with last
concepts.description: Replace the last additive term when multiplying.
